name: KAIST app QR public name and isolation rehearsal
trigger: Deploy two static app artifacts into a temporary Nexus app root, resolve each HTTPS QR hostname through the fake name resolver, then exercise the actual Nexus app-host handler.
observe: both QR targets render the expected app
one app session cannot query the other app
browser storage is isolated by public origin
HTTP and malformed names fail closed
expected: The fake app deployment and public-name boundary exercise the production Nexus app-host, while cookies, app database rows, and browser storage remain isolated across the two app origins.
